title: Vintage Playboy Magazine July 1963 w/ Centerfold Carrie Enwright The Bunnies
descriptionText: The product is a vintage issue of Playboy Magazine from July 1963 featuring centerfold Carrie Enwright and the iconic Bunnies. This collectible magazine is a first edition publication in English, with a monthly publication frequency. The magazine is known for its illustrated content, focusing on topics related to art, photography, men, fashion, and modeling. Originating from the United States, this publication offers a glimpse into the cultural and artistic landscape of the early 1960s, making it a valuable addition to any collector's library.
